arXiv:2608.02392v1 [cs.CV] 2026 年 8 月 3 日arXiv:2608.02392v1 [cs.CV] 03 Aug 2026

GROVE：来自流视频体验的时间分层记忆的增长和推理GROVE: Growing and Reasoning over Temporally Stratified Memory from Streaming Video Experience

Sitong Gong1,2, Caixin Kang2,3\equalcontrib, Tianyu Yan1,2\equalcontrib, Guo Chen4, Bo Zheng2, Kaipeng Zhang2, Yunzhi Zhuge1, Xiang Ruan1, Huchuan Lu1, Yifei Huang2,3\corresponding
摘要Abstract

可穿戴助手应该既能回答有关其视觉历史的问题，又能识别该历史何时对当前情况有用。现有的视频记忆系统主要支持问题条件回忆，而主动助理通常使用单独的记忆和控制机制。我们引入了 GROVE，这是一种无需训练的框架，它通过从连续视频流中因果增长的一个记忆来支持这两种行为。 GROVE 保留细粒度的感知证据，并逐步将其整合为带有时间戳的时刻、连贯的事件和重复出现的跨日模式。每个层都配有尺度原生检索技能，用于定位观察、重播活动或遍历长期规律性。反应式 QA 和主动式协助共享此内存和访问接口，区别在于检索是由用户查询发起还是由当前情况发起。在多个基准测试中，包括具有挑战性的 MM-lifelong 和 EgoServe，GROVE 在比较方法中取得了最佳结果。受控消融表明，时间层及其访问技能是互补的，当证据跨越多天时，模式提供最大的好处。 代码将在以下位置提供：A wearable assistant should both answer questions about its visual history and recognize when that history is useful to the present situation. Existing video-memory systems primarily support question-conditioned recall, whereas proactive assistants typically use separate memory and control mechanisms. We introduce GROVE, a training-free framework that supports both behaviors with one memory grown causally from a continuous video stream. GROVE retains fine-grained perceptual evidence and incrementally consolidates it into time-stamped moments, coherent episodes, and recurring cross-day patterns. Each stratum is paired with a scale-native retrieval skill for locating an observation, replaying an activity, or traversing long-range regularities. Reactive QA and proactive assistance share this memory and access interface, differing in whether retrieval is initiated by a user query or the current situation. Across multiple benchmarks including the challenging MM-lifelong and EgoServe, GROVE achieves the best results among the compared methods. Controlled ablations show that the temporal strata and their access skills are complementary, with patterns providing the largest benefit when evidence spans multiple days. Code will be available athttps://github.com/SitongGong/GROVE.

简介Introduction

可穿戴助手可以从用户的角度观察世界数小时、数天甚至数周。为了在这段不断发展的历史中继续提供帮助，它必须支持两种互补形式的援助。当用户询问“我昨天把钥匙落在哪里了？”时，助理必须A wearable assistant observes the world from its user’s perspective for hours, days, or even weeks. To remain helpful over this growing history, it must support two complementary forms of assistance. When a user asks, “Where did I leave my keys yesterday?”, the assistant must拉pull过去的相关证据。当用户要重复错误时，应该改为relevant evidence from the past. When the user is about to repeat a mistake, it should instead推push无需询问即可及时提供帮助。因此，反应式问答和主动式协助取决于相同的基础功能：将开放式视频流转变为随着时间的推移保持忠实、可搜索和可操作的记忆。timely assistance without being asked. Reactive question answering and proactive assistance therefore depend on the same underlying capability: turning an open-ended video stream into a memory that remains faithful, searchable, and actionable over time.

最近的视频存储系统已经解决了长视频和流视频的许多困难。他们构建在线事件记忆，分层组织经验，并使用迭代或代理检索来定位稀疏证据Recent video-memory systems already address many difficulties of long and streaming video. They construct online event memories, organize experience hierarchically, and use iterative or agentic retrieval to locate sparse evidence(Xie et al. 2026; Long et al. 2025; Li et al. 2026a; Chen et al. 2026a; Li et al. 2026b; Liang et al. 2026)。这些进步改变了过去存储和搜索的效率，但大多数都保持不变. These advances change how efficiently the past is stored and searched, but most retain the same查询优先query-first契约：明确的请求决定应该检索什么。相反，主动助理会根据当前情况来决定是否需要进行干预contract: an explicit request determines what should be retrieved. Proactive assistants instead use the current situation to decide whether intervention is warranted(Zhang et al. 2025b; Gong et al. 2026)，但它们的内存和控制机制主要是为服务触发而设计的，而不是作为开放式回忆的通用接口。因此，缺失的能力不仅仅是另一个记忆级别或更强的搜索过程。它是一个单一的流式存储器，可以从两个起始信号中的任何一个进行访问：寻求过去证据的问题或表明过去的经验现在可能有用的展开情况。, but their memory and control mechanisms are designed primarily for service triggering rather than as a common interface for open-ended recall. The missing capability is therefore not merely another memory level or a stronger search procedure. It is a single streaming memory that can be accessed from either of two starting signals: a question seeking past evidence or the unfolding situation indicating that past experience may now be useful.

我们的关键想法是使时间尺度成为内存存储内容和智能体读取方式之间的接口。视频助理所需的证据随规模的不同而发生质的变化：对象计数或状态变化可能会持续几秒钟，一项活动可能会在几分钟内展开，而一个例程可能只有在相关活动重复几天后才会出现。将这些观察结果视为同质记录迫使一项常规搜索行动恢复根本不同类型的证据。在 GROVE 中，每个尺度代表一种不同类型的信息，并公开适合该信息的访问操作。因此，层次结构不仅用于压缩视频；还用于压缩视频。它决定了如何推理存储的经验。长程规律是明确构建的，因为它们不存在于任何单独的帧或事件中，并且所有内存更新都是因果关系，以便在流仍然到达时内存保持可用。Our key idea is to make temporal scale the interface between what memory stores and how an agent reads it. Evidence required by a video assistant varies qualitatively with scale: an object count or state change may last seconds, an activity may unfold over minutes, and a routine may emerge only after related activities recur across days. Treating these observations as homogeneous records forces one general search operation to recover fundamentally different kinds of evidence. In GROVE, each scale instead represents a distinct kind of information and exposes an access operation suited to that information. The hierarchy is therefore not used only to compress the video; it determines how the stored experience can be reasoned over. Long-range regularities are explicitly constructed because they are absent from any individual frame or event, and all memory updates are causal so that the memory remains usable while the stream is still arriving.

我们实现了这个想法We realize this idea in格罗夫GROVE (G划船和rowing andR推理easoningO版本流媒体ver StreamingV想法ideoExperience），一个无需训练的框架，可以在线增长时间分层记忆。每个到达的视频窗口都通过两个互补的感知通道进行处理：一个叙述性标题和一个包含实体、属性、显式计数、动作和屏幕文本的结构化感知注册表。这些观察结果被整合为带有时间戳的时刻、连贯的情节和捕获重复行为的跨情节模式。 GROVE 公开了四种规模原生检索技能（xperience), a training-free framework that grows a temporally stratified memory online. Each arriving video window is processed through two complementary perception channels: a narrative caption and a structured perceptual registry containing entities, attributes, explicit counts, actions, and on-screen text. These observations are consolidated into time-stamped moments, coherent episodes, and cross-episode patterns capturing recurring behavior. GROVE exposes four scale-native retrieval skills (感知查找Perception Lookup, 瞬间回忆Moment Recall, 剧集重播Episode Replay, 和, and模式遍历Pattern Traversal）以增加的时间范围进入内存。多轮智能体组合这些技能并积累非冗余证据。) that enter the memory at increasing temporal scope. A multi-round agent composes these skills and accumulates non-redundant evidence.

相同的内存和技能库支持两种控制策略。对于The same memory and skill library support two control policies. For反应性的reactive问答时，用户查询启动决策-检索-答案循环，其中代理选择要检索的证据的类型和规模。对于question answering, the user query initiates a decide–retrieve–answer loop in which the agent selects the type and scale of evidence to retrieve. For主动的proactive在代理决定是否以及何时采取行动之前，前瞻性请求或当前感知状态会启动相关时刻、事件和模式的检索。这两项政策通过相同的规模原生接口读取相同的构建过去。assistance, either a forward-looking request or the current perceptual state initiates retrieval of related moments, episodes, and patterns before the agent decides whether and when to act. The two policies read the same constructed past through the same scale-native interface.

我们在 MM-Lifelong 上评估 GROVEWe evaluate GROVE on MM-Lifelong(Chen et al. 2026c), OVO 工作台, OVO-Bench(Niu et al. 2025), 流媒体平台, StreamingBench(Lin et al. 2026), ESTP-基准, ESTP-Bench(Zhang et al. 2025b)，和自我服务, and EgoServe(Gong et al. 2026)，涵盖终身问答、在线视频理解、转发协助、无问询主动服务。在所有三个基准测试的比较方法中，GROVE 取得了最佳的总体结果。受控消融表明，记忆的时间组织及其尺度感知检索界面都有助于这些收益。完整的设计还提高了检索效率，与平面字幕索引相比，需要更少的推理轮次和更低的延迟。, covering lifelong question answering, online video understanding, forward assistance, and query-free proactive services. GROVE achieves the best overall results among the compared methods on all three benchmarks. Controlled ablations show that both the temporal organization of memory andits scale-aware retrieval interface contribute to these gains. The full design also improves retrieval efficiency, requiring fewer reasoning rounds and lower latency than a flat caption index.

我们的贡献有三方面：Our contributions are threefold:

  • •

    我们将长视频内存制定为反应式问答和主动式协助的共享基础。We formulate long-video memory as a shared substrate for reactive question answering and proactive assistance.

  • •

    我们介绍 GROVE，We introduce GROVE, a因果的、时间分层的记忆causal, temporally stratified memory与规模原生检索技能相结合。paired with scale-native retrieval skills.

  • •

    在 5 个基准测试中，我们展示了这种共享内存和检索接口的有效性，并通过消融验证了其内存结构和检索设计。Across 5 benchmarks, we demonstrate the effectiveness of this shared memory and retrieval interface, with ablations validating both its memory structure and retrieval design.

These systems tie the trigger decision to current perception; none is built on a memory that also serves reactive reasoning, and none exposes the cross-day structure that long-term services require.

规模原生检索技能Scale-Native Retrieval Skills

GROVE 曝光四项GROVE exposes four规模原生scale-native检索技能，每层一项（表retrieval skills, one per stratum (Table1）。由于各层以不同的粒度存储不同的证据，因此每项技能都按请求的规模进入内存，而不是在一个平面索引中对所有记录类型进行排序。一项技能可以提供多个调用，但所有调用共享源层和返回粒度。它们接受关键字或语义查询以及时间范围（如果可用）。这四种技能共同定义了行动空间). Because the strata store different evidence at different granularities, each skill enters the memory at the requested scale instead of ranking all record types in one flat index. A skill may provide several calls, but all calls share a source stratum and return granularity. They accept keywords or a semantic query and, when available, a time range. Together, the four skills define the action space𝒜\mathcal{A}。基准测试可能仅公开其任务所需的子集。. A benchmark may expose only the subset required by its task.

感知查找。Perception Lookup.这个技能读取This skill readsℛ\mathcal{R}在请求的时间并返回附近的标题或结构化实体计数、属性、事件和屏幕文本。它提供细粒度的问题并基于当前场景的实时查询。at a requested time and returns nearby captions or structured entity counts, attributes, events, and on-screen text. It serves fine-grained questions and grounds real-time queries in the present scene.

瞬间回忆。Moment Recall.该技能搜索This skill searchesℱ\mathcal{F}按关键字和时间跨度，返回匹配的时间戳时刻或间隔内的有序序列。它解决了“何时发生”的问题，而无需重播整个过程by keyword and time span, returning matching time-stamped moments or the ordered sequence within an interval. It addresses what-happened-when questions without replaying an entire.

剧集重播。Episode Replay.该技能搜索This skill searches总结或阅读最近的单元summaries or reads recent units inℰ\mathcal{E}，然后返回所选活动的详细描述和跨度, then returns the selected activity’s detailed description and span[t0,t1][t_{0},t_{1}]。该跨度可以限制后续的感知查找或时刻回忆调用，提供从粗到细的路径。. The span can constrain subsequent Perception Lookup or Moment Recall calls, providing a coarse-to-fine path.

模式遍历。Pattern Traversal.该技能遵循群体边缘This skill follows group edges along𝒫→ℰ→ℱ\mathcal{P}{\to}\mathcal{E}{\to}\mathcal{F}，每个阶段都会限制下一个阶段的候选人。当广泛或跨时期查询未指定时间范围时，它非常有用。在每个阶段，互惠排名融合结合了 BM25 和密集语义排名，以便命名实体和释义概念保持可达性。遍历也可以开始于, with each stage constraining the candidates at the next. It is useful when a broad or cross-period query does not specify a time range. At each stage, reciprocal rank fusion combines BM25 and dense semantic rankings so that both named entities and paraphrased concepts remain reachable. 实验Experiments

实验装置Experimental Setup

基准和评估。Benchmarks and Evaluation.我们根据 5 个代表性基准评估我们的方法。We evlauate our method on 5 representative benchmarks.自我服务EgoServe (Gong et al. 2026)包含 10 个服务子类型的 3,000 多个主动服务实例，通过 Macro-F1 和法学硕士评判的质量评分进行衡量。contains over 3,000 proactive service instances across ten service sub-types, measured with Macro-F1 and an LLM-judged quality score.MM-终身MM-Lifelong (Chen et al. 2026c)包含 181.1 小时的视频 跨日、周和月尺度划分，评估终身 根据官方 GPT-5 法官协议进行问答。comprises 181.1 hours of video across day-, week-, and month-scale splits, evaluating lifelong question answering under the official GPT-5 judge protocol.OVO 工作台OVO-Bench (Niu et al. 2025)在线评价 跨向后追踪、实时感知和的视频理解 转发主动响应。evaluates online video comprehension across backward tracing, real-time perception, and forward active responding.流媒体平台StreamingBench (Lin et al. 2026)评估实时和上下文视频理解 流约束。assesses real-time and contextual video understanding under a streaming constraint.ESTP-工作台ESTP-Bench (Zhang et al. 2025b)通过基于时间的问题评估自我主动的视频理解 时机成熟，与官方进球evaluates ego-proactive video understanding through temporally grounded questions timed at opportune moments, scored with the official有效分数F1validScoreF1每个任务类型的平均指标。metric averaged per task type.

实施细节。Implementation details.感知和字幕生成使用Qwen3.5-35B-A3BPerception and caption generation use Qwen3.5-35B-A3B(Team 2026)，而内存整合则使用GPT-4.1-mini。 MM-Lifelong 的推理主干是 GPT-5.2，其他基准的推理主干是 GPT-5-mini。本地视频处理在 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上运行。对于 MM-Lifelong 和 EgoServe，我们每 5 秒采样一帧，并将剧集上限设置为 10 分钟；对于其余的基准测试，我们每 2 秒采样一帧，并将剧集限制在 2 分钟。补充材料中提供了特定于数据集的配置以及所有构造和推理提示。, while memory consolidation uses GPT-4.1-mini. The reasoning backbone is GPT-5.2 for MM-Lifelong and GPT-5-mini for the other benchmarks. Local video processing runs on NVIDIA H200 GPUs. For MM-Lifelong and EgoServe, we sample one frame every 5s and cap episodes at 10min; for the remaining benchmarks, we sample one frame every 2s and cap episodes at 2min. Dataset-specific configurations and all construction and inference prompts are provided in the supplementary material.

主要结果Main Results

自我服务。Egoserve.GROVE 在 EgoServe 上实现了最佳整体宏观 F1 (12.6)，超出 EgoMemo 4.6 分，并在十个服务子类型中的七个中排名第一（表GROVE achieves the best overall macro-F1 on EgoServe (12.6), exceeding EgoMemo by 4.6 points and ranking first on seven of ten service subtypes (Table2）。其最大的进步出现在安全性（19.7 vs. 12.5）、工具使用（20.2 vs. 7.5）和错误恢复（23.8 vs. 1.7）方面，这取决于当前和最近的细粒度证据。 GROVE 还可以改善习惯 辅导（8.6 vs. 3.7）和记忆关联提醒（6.5 vs. 4.9），跨情节背景非常有用。). Its largest gains occur in safety (19.7 vs. 12.5), tool use (20.2 vs. 7.5), and error recovery (23.8 vs. 1.7), which depend on fine-grained current and recent evidence. GROVE also improves habit coaching (8.6 vs. 3.7) and memory-linked reminders (6.5 vs. 4.9), where cross-episode context is useful.

MM-终身。MM-Lifelong.关于 MM-终身（表On MM-Lifelong (Table3），GROVE 获得最佳成绩 所有三个方面的得分：23.50（日）、22.75（周）和 19.98 （月），超越最强者 代理基线 ReMA 分别提高了 6.75、3.93 和 1.36 点。一天中的增益最大，感知轨迹和时间戳时刻保留了计数、属性、文本和操作时间等细节。较长时期内较小但一致的收益表明，这些细粒度的证据在整合后仍然可以获得。), GROVE gets the best score on all three horizons: 23.50 (day), 22.75 (week), and 19.98 (month), improving over the strongest agentic baseline ReMA by 6.75, 3.93, and 1.36 points, respectively. The gain is largest on the day split, where the perceptual trace and time-stamped moments preserve details such as counts, attributes, text, and action timing. The smaller but consistent gains at longer horizons indicate that this fine-grained evidence remains accessible after consolidation.

OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench。OVO-Bench and StreamingBench.在 OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 上（表On OVO-Bench and StreamingBench (Table4），GROVE 在比较模型中获得了最好的 OVO-Bench 总体得分（67.5）和 StreamingBench 平均得分（65.1）。它领先于 OVO 实时感知（76.2），同时在后向追踪上获得 69.9 分，在前向主动响应上获得 56.5 分。在 StreamingBench 上，它的上下文理解得分为 53.1，比列出的最强基线高出 9.2 分，同时在实时理解方面保持竞争力（77.0 比 77.3）。这些结果表明，对观察到的历史进行检索可以改善时间上下文问题，而不会牺牲当前窗口的基础。), GROVE obtains the best OVO-Bench overall score (67.5) and StreamingBench average (65.1) among the compared models. It leads OVO real-time perception (76.2), while obtaining 69.9 on backward tracing and 56.5 on forward active responding. On StreamingBench, it achieves 53.1 on contextual understanding, 9.2 points above the strongest listed baseline, while remaining competitive on real-time understanding (77.0 vs. 77.3). These results show that retrieval over the observed history improves temporally contextual questions without sacrificing grounding in the current window.

ESTP 工作台。ESTP-Bench.在 ESTP-Bench 上（表On ESTP-Bench (Table5），GROVE 在非特定基准比较方法中获得了最佳上下文问题得分（41.0 vs. 26.6）和最佳总体得分（28.6 vs. 22.9）。它还领先于显式主动任务（22.7），但在隐式主动任务上落后于 Qwen2-VL（34.4 与 39.3）。巨大的背景增益与 GROVE 的设计是一致的：这些问题从当前与早期事件的联系中获益最多。), GROVE achieves the best contextual-question score among the non-benchmark-specific comparison methods (41.0 vs. 26.6) and the best overall score (28.6 vs. 22.9). It also leads the explicit proactive track (22.7), but trails Qwen2-VL on implicit proactive tasks (34.4 vs. 39.3). The large contextual gain is consistent with GROVE’s design: these questions benefit most from connecting the present to earlier events.

结构和效率。Structure and efficiency.从平面标题索引开始，我们一次添加一层 固定检索预算，并与检索结果一起衡量准确性 每个问题的代币、已实现轮次和延迟 （表Starting from a flat caption index, we add one stratum back at a time with the retrieval budget fixed, and measure accuracy together with the retrieved tokens, realized rounds, and latency per question (Table9）。准确度随着 层次结构已恢复（12.75). Accuracy increases monotonically as the hierarchy is restored (12.75→\to18.75），而代理需要18.75), while the agent needs更少fewer回合（6.25rounds (6.25→\to4.95) 和更少的时间 (59.34.95) and less time (59.3→\to47.6 s）来回答。结构 因此，立即购买了准确性和效率：由 时间尺度让智能体直接获得正确的证据，而不是 寻找通往它的道路。47.6 s) to answer. Structure therefore buys accuracy and efficiency at once: a memory organized by temporal scale lets the agent reach the right evidence directly instead of searching its way toward it.

推理时间分析Inference-Time Analysis

我们分析系统两侧的成本：代理推理阶段的检索预算和内存构建阶段的推理时间。We analyse costs on both sides of the system: the retrieval budget in the agentic reasoning stage and the inference time in the memory construction stage.

检索预算。Retrieval budget.为了探索检索预算如何影响准确性和成本，我们在内存固定的情况下改变最大检索轮数。准确性是在全天时间段内进行衡量的，而每个问题的提示标记和 LLM 时间则是在一批 20 个问题上进行分析。 如图所示To explore how the retrieval budget affects accuracy and cost, we vary the maximum number of retrieval rounds with the memory fixed. Accuracy is measured on the full day split, while the prompt tokens and LLM time per question are profiled on a batch of 20 questions. As illustrated in Fig.3(a)，准确率在八轮时达到峰值 (18.75)， 下降到超过它（10 时 15.33），而令牌和延迟几乎增长 与预算呈线性关系。因此，一旦额外检索就不再有回报 证据充分——进一步的电话大多增加了低信息 上下文 - 所以我们将预算设置为八轮，其中代理 平均 4.95 轮后自行终止。(a), accuracy peaks at eight rounds (18.75) and declines beyond it (15.33 at ten), whereas tokens and latency grow almost linearly with the budget. Additional retrieval thus stops paying off once the evidence is sufficient-further calls mostly add low-information context-so we set the budget to eight rounds throughout, where the agent self-terminates after 4.95 rounds on average.

记忆建构。Memory construction.为了加速构建，我们将字幕、剧集分段和时刻/模式整合作为三个重叠的异步阶段来运行。图。To accelerate construction, we run captioning, episode segmentation, and moment/pattern consolidation as three overlapping asynchronous stages. Fig.3(b) 报告跨采样率和窗口计数的视频每分钟构建时间：它从 78.2 秒下降到 19.5 秒，从每五秒一帧开始超过实时时间，并在最稀疏设置下达到 3.08 倍。因此，构建可以与实时流保持同步，在不改变内存结构的情况下以时间分辨率换取吞吐量。(b) reports the build time per minute of video across sampling rates and window counts: it drops from 78.2 to 19.5 seconds, exceeding real time from one frame every five seconds onward and reaching 3.08× at the sparsest setting. Construction can thus keep pace with a live stream, trading temporal resolution for throughput without altering the memory structure.

定性分析Qualitative Analysis

图。Fig.4展示了三种情况。在第一个例子中，GROVE 在几个小时的无关镜头中找到了火锅情节，并从其感知痕迹中读取了饮料，与地面事实相匹配。在第二个过程查询中，它重播烹饪片段并按照其有序时刻恢复下一步。在第三个中，在根本没有查询的情况下，它遍历连接第 4 天集会和第 1 天会话的模式并提供较早的记录。这些案例显示，一次内存读取的规模适合被动和主动使用。shows three cases. In the first, GROVE locates the hot-pot episode among hours of unrelated footage and reads the drink from its perceptual trace, matching the ground truth. In the second, a procedural query, it replays the cooking episode and follows its ordered moments to recover the next step. In the third, with no query at all, it traverses the pattern linking the Day-4 assembly to the Day-1 session and offers the earlier record. The cases show one memory read at the right scale for both reactive and proactive use.

结论Conclusion

我们提出了 GROVE，一个无需培训的框架，可以组织流媒体视频 记忆及其在时间尺度上的访问。 GROVE 因果转变 将传入的观察结果转化为感知轨迹、带有时间戳的时刻、连贯的 事件和重复出现的模式，并具有专门针对每个事件的检索技能 地层。反应式 QA 和主动式协助共享这种记忆和技能 图书馆。五个结果 基准测试以及受控消融表明，时间配对 具有规模原生访问的结构提高了长视野召回率和 情境意识援助。因此，GROVE 提供了实用的内存 助理必须不断观察、记忆和行动的基础。We presented GROVE, a training-free framework that organizes streaming video memory and its access around temporal scale. GROVE causally transforms incoming observations into a perceptual trace, time-stamped moments, coherent episodes, and recurring patterns, with a retrieval skill specialized for each stratum. Reactive QA and proactive assistance share this memory and skill library. Results across five benchmarks, together with controlled ablations, show that pairing temporal structure with scale-native access improves both long-horizon recall and situation-aware assistance. GROVE therefore provides a practical memory substrate for assistants that must continuously observe, remember, and act.

局限性Limitations

GROVE 继承了其冻结感知模型的错误，并且在摄取过程中丢失的证据无法通过以后的整合来恢复。仅当情节结束时才会更新更高级别的内存，因此当前窗口查询依赖于感知跟踪。随着观察到的历史记录的增长，内存构建和多轮检索的成本也变得更高。最后，由于主要基准测试使用不同的推理主干，因此组件级结论依赖于固定主干消融，而不是绝对的交叉基准结果。GROVE inherits errors from its frozen perception model, and evidence missed during ingestion cannot be recovered through later consolidation. Higher-level memory is updated only when an episode closes, so current-window queries rely on the perceptual trace. Memory construction and multi-round retrieval also become more costly as the observed history grows. Finally, because the main benchmarks use different reasoning backbones, component-level conclusions rely on the fixed-backbone ablations rather than absolute cross-benchmark results.

围绕分段器的确定性规则。Deterministic Rules around the Segmenter.LLM 分段器接收到达窗口的帧级标题 结合打开单元最近的三个窗口，对整个窗口进行二元判断。 它比较了两者的稳定锚点：高层活动是否 继续，地点是否发生变化，涉及的关键物体和人员是否仍然存在。仅当发生此类更改时才声明边界 适用于整个窗口，然后关闭打开的单元The LLM segmenter receives the frame-level captions of the arriving window together with those of the three most recent windows of the open unit and makes a binary judgment on the window as a whole. 特定于数据集的实例化。Dataset-specific Instantiations.各个基准的构建在其他方面都是相同的，但为了公平起见，我们明确指出了三个例外。 (i) 标题和提取提示是专门针对场景（通用第三人称 QA、第一人称工具操作和第一人称日常生活）而设计的，以便感知阶段关注每个领域所需的证据。 (ii) 在 EgoServe 的两个教学子集上，系统被赋予 基准本身定义的任务级别优先。在 HoloAssist 上 提取阶段接收声明的录音任务类型，其规范 步骤序列，以及该任务类型的已知错误模式的简短列表。在 CaptainCook4D 上，筛选提示会收到正在执行的菜谱的正确步骤顺序，这些步骤顺序取自按拓扑顺序排列的官方任务图（最多 25 个步骤）。两者都是部署的助手在会话开始之前掌握的任务知识，并且都遵循这些基准的设置，其中相对于已知过程定义错误检测。 (iii) 在 OVO-Bench 和 ESTP-Bench 的前瞻性轨道上，系统必须决定的地方Construction is otherwise identical across benchmarks, with three exceptions that we state explicitly for fairness. (i) Caption and extraction prompts are designed specifically to scenario—generic third-person QA, first-person tool manipulation, and first-person daily life—so that the perception stage attends to the evidence each domain requires. (ii) On the two instructional subsets of EgoServe, the system is given the task-level prior that the benchmarks themselves define. On HoloAssist the extraction stage receives the declared task type of the recording, its canonical step sequence, and a short list of known error patterns for that task type. On CaptainCook4D the screening prompt receives the correct step sequence of the recipe being performed, taken from the official task graphs in topological order (at most twenty-five steps). Both are the kind of task knowledge a deployed assistant holds before a session starts, and both follow the setting of these benchmarks, in which error detection is defined relative to a known procedure. (iii) On the forward-looking tracks of OVO-Bench and ESTP-Bench, where the system must decide当when为了说话而不是回答事后提出的问题，视频的候选用户问题在构建阶段是可见的；这遵循这些轨道的协议，其中预先知道前向查询并且仅评估其触发时间。在 MM-Lifelong、StreamingBench 和 OVO-Bench 的向后轨道上构建期间没有出现任何问题。to speak rather than answer a question posed afterwards, the candidate user questions of a video are visible to the construction stage; this follows the protocol of these tracks, in which the forward query is known in advance and only its firing time is evaluated. No question is visible during construction on MM-Lifelong, StreamingBench, and backward tracks of OVO-Bench.

A.2 不同基准上的检索细节A.2 Retrieval Details on Different Benchmarks

主论文的四个技能是抽象接口；基准测试实例化的内容取决于内存的访问方式，这将五个基准测试分为两组。在 MM-Lifelong、OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 上，每轮都会打开一个查询，因此代理会在多轮预算下选择自己的调用， 遵循基于技能的代理推理范式。开 ESTP-Bench和EgoServe，不提出查询或转发请求，因此通过固定模式为代理执行检索，该固定模式为每个筛选单元组装一个证据块，遵循基于模式的主动辅助范例。 表The four skills of the main paper are abstract interfaces; what a benchmark instantiates depends on how the memory is accessed, which divides the five benchmarks into two groups. On MM-Lifelong, OVO-Bench and StreamingBench, a query opens each round, so the agent selects its own calls under a multi-round budget, following the skill-based agentic reasoning paradigm. On ESTP-Bench and EgoServe, no query or a forward request is posed, so retrieval is carried out for the agent by a fixed schema that assembles one evidence block per screening unit, following the schema-based proactive assistance paradigm. 基于模式的主动协助Schema-based Proactive Assistance

ESTP 工作台。ESTP-Bench.系统必须决定The system must decide当when和and如何how回答一个长期存在的问题 而不是按需回答，因此检索是通过模式而不是 而不是由代理发出呼叫。在流的每一步，代理都会看到 当前步骤的密集标题，与其先前步骤的交互历史记录 答案及其时间戳，以及 - 当问题需要扎根时 过去——从过去为它组装的证据块to answer a standing question rather than answer on demand, so retrieval is carried out by the schema rather than issued as a call by the agent. At each step of the stream the agent sees the dense caption of the current step, the interaction history with its own earlier answers and their timestamps, and — when the question calls for grounding in the past — an evidence block assembled for it from the和 感知痕迹层与覆盖物and perceptual trace strata together with the coverings。 该块只能将响应的内容接地，并且 永远不会自行触发，这会阻止检索到的历史记录触发 在没有现有证据的情况下回答。这两个设置到达该块 不同的是：在对话环境中，它无条件地组装在 每一步，而在单查询设置中，代理首先从 单独存在，并且最多只有在要求接地时才组装该块 每个问题一次。因此，预算是故意不对称的——目前 随时可用，可根据要求提供过去的信息 - 并且s. This block may only ground the content of a response and never triggers one by itself, which prevents retrieved history from firing an answer in the absence of present evidence. The two settings reach that block differently: in the conversational setting it is assembled unconditionally at every step, whereas in the single-query setting the agent first judges from the present alone, and the block is assembled only once it asks for grounding, at most once per question. The budget is therefore deliberately asymmetric — the present is always available, the past on request — and99.2%99.2\%的回复是 完全无需任何检索即可提交，这就是使模式保持经济实惠的原因 以流媒体速率。of responses are committed without any retrieval at all, which is what keeps the schema affordable at streaming rates.

这两种设置在定义决策步骤的内容以及决策频率方面也有所不同。 重新考虑决定。在单查询设置中，问题来自 片段开始，并在每个二级标题中重新审视该决定； 在对话设置中，流被分组为开始的短窗口 在每次轮流被问及时，将对话进行到目前为止，并重新审视 对于其答案必须跟踪正在进行的任务的轮流更密集。一个回应是 锚定在智能体选择的第二个位置，并固定为因果关系，然后重复 出于相同意图的解雇被禁止两次——通过指示不要这样做 除非出现新的情况，否则重述答案，并且重述的最小间隙为The two settings also differ in what defines a decision step and in how often the decision is revisited. In the single-query setting, the question stands from the start of the segment and the decision is revisited at every second-level caption; in the conversational setting the stream is grouped into short windows that begin at the moment each turn is asked, carry the dialogue so far, and are revisited more densely for turns whose answer must track a task in progress. A response is anchored at a second chosen by the agent and clamped to be causal, and repeated firings of the same intent are suppressed twice over — by an instruction not to restate an answer unless something new appears, and by a hard minimum gap of88s 在连续响应之间，收紧至s between consecutive responses, tightened to44s 用于询问系统的问题 对发生的每个子步骤进行评论。s for questions that ask the system to comment on each sub-step as it happens.

We keep the segment-level evidence block but redraw its boundaries: instead of the content-driven边界，相同的跨度被切割成boundaries, the same span is cut into the相同的号码same number等长的片段，每个片段都填充了它所覆盖的字幕，每个记录的计数都匹配（在 EgoLife 上每天，剪辑是在包含视频的跨度内绘制的，这样睡眠和离开期间就不会消耗片段）。因此，筛选窗口、片段计数和证据量保持不变，唯一的变量是边界落在哪里。消除自适应分段成本of equal-length segments, each filled with the captions it covers, with the count matched per recording (and per day on EgoLife, where the cuts are drawn inside the spans that contain video so that sleep and away periods do not consume segments). The screening windows, the segment count and the evidence volume are therefore unchanged, and the only variable is where the boundaries fall. Removing adaptive segmentation costs12.62→12.1712.62\!\rightarrow\!12.17总体而言，损失集中在两个服务上，其决策必须锚定于特定的时刻：安全警报下降overall, and the loss concentrates on the two services whose decision must be anchored to a particular second: safety alerts drop19.7→14.119.7\!\rightarrow\!14.1和习惯辅导and habit coaching8.6→4.28.6\!\rightarrow\!4.2，在这两种情况下，因为匹配预测的数量完全下降（, in both cases because the number of matched predictions falls outright (49→3549\!\rightarrow\!35和and6→36\!\rightarrow\!3）在预测量不变的情况下——仍然发出响应，但它们不再落在容差窗口内。固定长度的单元不再在活动开始和结束的地方开始和结束，因此基于决策的摘要混合了两个活动，并且触发秒偏离了它应该标记的事件。) at an unchanged prediction volume — the responses are still issued, but they no longer land inside the tolerance window. A fixed-length unit no longer begins and ends where the activity does, so the summary grounding the decision mixes two activities and the trigger second drifts from the event it should mark.

 TOPIC_MATCH_LIFE_PROMPT

阶段/入口：模式/主题聚合Stage / entry: Pattern/Topic Aggregation

⬇
你You 是are 匹配matching a 新的new 情节episode to 现有的existing 主题topics in a 视频video 记忆memory 系统system 为了for a 第一FIRST-人PERSON 每日daily-生活life 录音recording (意高生活EgoLife: 相机camera-佩戴者wearer 分享sharing a 房子house 与with 室友roommates 结束over 多个multiple 天days).
A "主题topic" is 一号ONE 具体的specific, 有界的bounded 活动ACTIVITY 线程THREAD -- e.g. "制作Making 晚餐dinner 与with 室友roommates on 第2天Day2 晚上evening", "组装Assembling 的the 白色white 存储storage 架子shelf in 的the 生活living 房间room", "杂货店Grocery 购物shopping 旅行trip at 盒马Hema 超市supermarket", "演奏Playing 的the 桌面式tabletop 卡card 游戏game 之后after 午餐lunch". A 主题topic is 不NOT a 地点location ("厨房kitchen 东西stuff”），"), 不NOT a 整体whole 日day, 和and 不NOT a 反复出现的recurring 杂务chore 类别category ("清洁cleaning”）。").
## 比赛Match 标准criteria (‘比赛match=真实true‘)
- 的The 情节episode 直接DIRECTLY 继续CONTINUES 的the 一样same 有界的bounded 活动activity (一样same 餐meal 仍然still 存在being 煮熟的cooked/吃过eaten; 一样same 架子shelf 仍然still 存在being 组装的assembled; 一样same 购物shopping 旅行trip).
- 退货Returns to 的the 一样same 活动activity 之后after a 短short 中断interruption (电话phone 打电话call, 浴室bathroom 打破break) 内WITHIN 的the 一样same 会议session.
## 反Anti-图案patterns (‘比赛match=假的false‘)
- 一样Same 地点LOCATION 但是but 不同的different 活动activity (厨房kitchen: 烹饪cooking 晚餐dinner vs 洗涤washing 菜肴dishes 下一个next 早上morning = 不同DIFFERENT).
- 一样Same 类别CATEGORY on a 不同的different 场合occasion (今天today’s 午餐lunch vs 昨天yesterday’s 午餐lunch = 不同DIFFERENT 主题topics; a 第二second 修理repair 会议session 小时hours 后来later = 不同DIFFERENT 除非unless 明显地visibly 的the 一样same 未完成的unfinished 工作job 恢复resumed).
- A 非常very 长long-跑步running 模糊的vague 主题topic (一one 主题topic 吸收的absorbing 小时hours of 无关的unrelated 剧集episodes) -- if 的the 现有的existing 主题topic 已经already 跨度spans 许多many 剧集episodes 和and 这个this 新的new 情节episode is a 不同的different 会议session/场合occasion, 更喜欢prefer ‘比赛match=假的false‘.
- 模糊Vague 现有的existing 主题topic 标题title ("每日daily 活动activities", "工作working on 东西stuff") => 更喜欢prefer 假的false.
当When in 怀疑doubt, 输出output 假的false -- 具体的specific 有界的bounded 活动activity 线程threads 击败beat 巨人giant 抓住catch-所有alls.
